name: Seestüberl
beschreibung:
The Seestüberl – also known as the Kampler Seestube – is located at an altitude of around 1,000 metres right by Kampler See at the entrance to the Stubai Valley near Neustift im Stubaital. Open all year round, this excursion restaurant offers a cosy parlour and a sun terrace with views of the Elferspitze, Zwölferspitze, Brennerspitze and the Stubai Glacier.

It serves traditional, down-to-earth cuisine made with regionally produced ingredients, along with seasonal homemade cakes and ice cream sundaes. At Kampler See, adults and children alike can unwind: there is a public children's playground, an animal enclosure and, in summer, the opportunity to swim in the lake – although it is not an official swimming lake. Monday is the rest day; it is open Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 20:00.
